message: Scaled 1 of 2 feed rates to 80 %; 1 left as a thread pitch, 2 feeds under addresses of their own left as written (FA=, FB=). No machine: profile defaults assumed.

findings.message: F2 is a thread pitch (G71), not a feed rate, so it is not scaled: scaling it would cut a different thread.
FA=0.2 is a feed under an address of its own, not the F word, so it is left as it is. Change it by hand if it should follow the other feeds.
FB=0.15 is a feed under an address of its own, not the F word, so it is left as it is. Change it by hand if it should follow the other feeds.
